finance.title: Finance
finance.start: Add your main account and optionally a reserve account to get started.
finance.coverage: Projection based on recorded installments, recurring entries and estimates. Missing income and expenses are not included. Reserves do not automatically cover a negative operating balance.
finance.chartLegend: Green: income and reimbursements. Orange: expenses. Value below: monthly result. Select a month for details.
finance.noEntries: No entries recorded for this period.
finance.openingHint: Enter the balance at the start of the chosen date, before that day's movements. Leave blank if unknown. Earlier movements do not change this balance.
finance.cardHint: Record each charge on its expected payment date. In this version, mark the occurrence as paid; do not also add the full card bill as another expense.
finance.estimateHint: Enter the expected category total for the month. Entries already recorded for the same category and account reduce the estimate to avoid duplicates.
finance.entryHint: The amount is for one occurrence: one installment or month, not the full purchase. For installments, enter the number due on the selected date. Mark completed only after payment or receipt.
finance.name: Name
finance.invalidMoney: Enter an amount with at most two decimal places and no thousands separator.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.ready: Enable reminders even when Yper is closed.
notifications.install: On iPhone/iPad, open Yper from its Home Screen icon. Requires iOS 16.4 or later.
notifications.unsupported: This browser does not support notifications in this context. Use HTTPS and a supported browser.
notifications.unconfigured: Notifications still need to be configured on the server and in the app.
notifications.denied: Notifications are blocked. Allow them in your device or browser settings.
notifications.dismissed: Permission was not granted. You can try again later.
notifications.active: This device is registered for notifications.
notifications.scheduleHint: These times apply when you enable this device. Change the days and times or pause each reminder. Reminders are skipped if you already logged your weight or that meal today.
notifications.activated: Device enabled and schedule saved. Send a test to check delivery.
notifications.saved: Schedule saved. An enabled device is required to receive reminders.
notifications.testSent: Test sent to the notification service. Check your device.

recentWorkouts.title: Recent detailed sessions
recentWorkouts.empty: No recent detailed sessions. See the calendar in History.

workouts.title: Workouts
workouts.empty: Build your first workout to start logging sessions.

items.emptyGroup: No exercises registered in this group.
items.registerExercise: Register an exercise in another tab
items.unavailable: The original exercise is unavailable. Select a replacement or remove this item.
items.incomplete: Select a valid exercise for every item before saving.

session.sharedWeight: This weight applies to this exercise in every workout.

history.title: History
history.empty: Daily activity appears in the calendar. No detailed sessions recorded.

items.title: Exercises

nutrition.title: Nutrition
nutrition.empty: No meals logged on this day.

form.name: Name
form.noteAfter: When building a meal you enter the actual quantity and the macros are converted.

list.title: Measurements
list.empty: Log your first measurement to track your progress.

form.pastDateHint: You can also record weights from previous days.

dailyGoals.title: Daily goals
dailyGoals.note: Protein and carbs provide 4 kcal per gram, fat provides 9. The sum above helps check whether the macros match the calorie goal.

banking.title: Bank connections
banking.intro: Posted transactions update your finances automatically. Categorize later, individually or in bulk. Cards and bills are not imported yet.
banking.setup: Configure the personal Pluggy pilot on the API to discover authorized accounts. Yper does not request bank passwords.
banking.refreshHint: Checking reads provider data; it does not force a bank refresh. Pausing stops Yper reads, without revoking provider consent.
banking.noAvailable: No BRL bank accounts available. Check provider authorization and coverage.
banking.createAccount: Create your account in Finance first.
banking.syncFailed: The last read failed. Previous data was preserved.
banking.pendingHint: {count} exception(s) to review. New pending items are excluded from totals; linked discrepancies keep the previous entry until reviewed.
banking.bankPending: Not yet posted by the bank; cannot be included.
banking.changedHint: The bank changed this transaction. Undo the link and review the new data.
banking.rulesHint: Rules apply to future transactions. You can categorize multiple entries together. Disabling does not change history; undoing an entry does not disable its rule.
banking.reviewHint: Check whether this is a new expense/income, an existing entry, or an own-account transfer. Bill payments require dedicated reconciliation and should wait.
banking.similarHint: {count} similar transaction(s) found. Matching amounts and dates do not prove duplication.
banking.remember: Remember category for future transactions with this description
banking.confirmNew: I checked: this is a new transaction, not an own-account transfer or payment of an already counted bill.
banking.transferHint: In this release, both sides must be posted on the same date. Different dates remain for later review.
banking.undoConfirm: Undo this decision and remove the imported entry from totals? For transfers, both sides return to review.
banking.uncategorizedHint: {count} uncategorized transaction(s) already included in totals. Categorization is optional for updating amounts.
banking.syncPartial: Some accounts were not updated in this attempt. Check connections; accounts read less than a minute ago wait for the next interval.
banking.categoryOnly: Amounts are already in your finances. This changes only the category, without recreating entries.
banking.reason_duplicate: Possible duplicate: check the transaction identity.
banking.reason_transfer: Transfer to reconcile or insufficient ownership data.
banking.reason_special: Bill, reversal or operation requiring dedicated reconciliation.
banking.reason_changed: The bank changed a linked transaction.
banking.balanceHint: Connected account summaries show the latest bank-reported balance and its date. Transactions are not added to that balance again. Projections below still use opening balances and ledger entries.
